name: tunnel-browser
description: Браузер, который выходит в интернет только через Xray-туннель

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always -c.releaseInfo.releaseNotesFile=build/release-notes.md
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-xray.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac --publish always -c.releaseInfo.releaseNotesFile=build/release-notes.md

author: Tunnel Browser contributors
